name: memory-vault-client
description: Full authorized client for the open memory protocol: MCP, visible-turn capture, queued signed sync, host adapters and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory, opt-in sync and recovery
interface.longDescription: One open protocol with two equal usage paths: independent protocol adoption or this full authorized client. Includes MCP, opt-in visible-turn capture, a configured protocol bridge, multiple host adapters, bounded signed directory/rclone synchronization, content-free diagnostics, backup/restore, compressed packs and explicit update staging. No Task/Git control plane, transcript scanning, self-installation, key auto-enrollment or log suppression. Work automatic lifecycle and production validation are not claimed.
capabilities: Direct protocol and portable bundle access
Compressed resumable packs and staged updates
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant memory before this work.
Save this visible turn and its continuity.
Show the local memory record count.
